title: The UN Charter states the sovereign equality of all members
summary: The UN Charter states the sovereign equality of all members.
body: Article 2 says the Organization and its members shall act in accordance with stated principles, including the principle of the sovereign equality of all members. The source says: "The Organization is based on the principle of the sovereign equality of all its Members." Sovereign equality is a principle the Charter states. Voting rules in other articles are not identical to equality of votes.
